facts.fact: The Federal Ministry of Education states that it has launched the nationwide Learner Identification Number, a digital system giving every student a permanent identity, and that in the first phase over 1.9 million candidates registered for the 2026 WAEC and NECO examinations have been issued numbers; the launch is undated, so the document's published date is used.

The statement, issued by the Federal Ministry of Education's press director, presents the Learner Identification Number as the ministry's own system, launched by the minister; undated, so the document's published date is used.

systems.tiers: first phase: over 1.9 million 2026 WAEC and NECO candidates; next phase: all learners in public and private schools, through national data platforms and the Annual School Census

systems.system: Digitized National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)
systems.country_label: Digitized National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)
systems.tiers: a national register of schools, each with a ten-digit identification number
named as a route for extending the learner number to all learners

note: The statement gives no level for the first-phase learners beyond naming them as WAEC and NECO candidates, and does not say that schools enter anything; no levels, kept or schools fact is taken.
